notes: Tabletop Cryostation (56.3 x 23.2 x 49 cm, 29 kg) = cooling tower (vertical Al cylinder in a sheet-metal rear case housing a two-stage GM cryocooler on a vibration-damping support) + sample chamber (lower vacuum housing with side panels, radiation shield with 30 mm cold windows, lift-off upper housing with four radial + one top 50 mm windows), joined by a baseplate and a semi-rigid bellows. Beam height 137 mm; vibrations <5 nm p-p; cooling power 130 mW at 4.2 K; cooldown ~2 h to 4.2 K. Stage temperatures are the manual's troubleshooting 'general reference' for a standard CryoAdvance-50: Stage 1 27-28 K, Stage 2 2.4-2.7 K, platform 2.7-3.0 K, sample 2.8-3.2 K. The 'turbo_pump' entry stands for the integrated roughing pump of the standard 6U vacuum control module (a turbo is optional and not installed). Off-table: water-cooled SHI compressor 46 x 45 x 57 cm, 73 kg; 4U system control unit (13.6 kg); 6U vacuum control unit (23 kg). The brochure dimensions page is a drawing with no extractable numbers; sample-space height 116 mm (brochure) vs 63 mm inside shield (QD datasheet) are both reported.
